editing_notes.add_a_model: To recommend a new model, append one object to `models`. Editing this JSON is the ONLY step — never hardcode a model tag in application logic.
editing_notes.tag_footgun: NEVER a bare tag (e.g. 'qwen3', 'qwen3:4b'). A bare tag can resolve to a Thinking variant whose reasoning cannot be disabled — a documented footgun of this project. Always pin an explicit instruct variant + quantization, e.g. 'qwen3:30b-a3b-instruct-2507-q4_K_M'.
editing_notes.honesty: Keep every *_provenance field truthful. 'measured' = this project measured it on real hardware; 'estimated' = derived from the Q4 anchor (0.6 GB per billion params) or vendor specs; 'unmeasured' = unknown. Never relabel an estimate as measured.
editing_notes.verification: Only the `default` model is confirmed present on this project's node (hardware_verified: true). Every other tag is a recommendation — confirm it against `ollama` / the model registry before trusting it. class_b is the parameter count in billions.
editing_notes.moe_vs_dense: Two different physics. RAM footprint = f(TOTAL params) = class_b (all weights must be resident). Generation speed = f(ACTIVE params) = active_b (only the routed experts compute per token). For a dense model active_b == class_b. The measured 35 tok/s belongs to the MoE anchor (~3.3B active) and must NOT be extrapolated to a dense model of similar total size — a dense 30B is far slower. Keep `arch` and `active_b` truthful on every entry.

provenance_legend.measured: observed on this project's real hardware
provenance_legend.estimated: derived from the measured Q4 anchor (0.6 GB/B) plus standard headroom
provenance_legend.unmeasured: not measured; unknown on this project's hardware

models.throughput_context: warm/resident, x86 mini-PC APU + integrated GPU (Vulkan). MoE: this speed reflects ~3.3B ACTIVE params, not 30.5B — it does NOT transfer to a dense model of similar total size.
models.best_for: General reasoning, coding, and the mentor chat — this project's measured anchor.
Strong reasoning on a 16GB+ box when the 30B class does not fit comfortably.
Balanced everyday assistant on a mid-range laptop or mini-PC.
Small SBCs and low-RAM boxes; quick drafts and summaries, weaker reasoning.
The smallest edge boxes; classification and short drafts, weakest reasoning.
